items.title: Exercise interventions for gait and balance performances among older adults with sarcopenic obesity: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (13 studies, n=502) on exercise interventions for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity found exercise training (power, resistance, multicomponent) improved gait speed, step length, functional mobility, static balance, and postural control, with mild adverse effects. Most studies (nearly 70%) were on older women, limiting generalizability to older men.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，运动训练对肌少性肥胖老年人的步态和平衡表现有潜在益处。在为这类患者设计康复方案时，可优先考虑力量训练、有氧训练及多组分训练，但需注意现有研究多集中于老年女性，对老年男性的普适性仍待进一步证实。
items.titleZh: 肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡表现的运动干预：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对肌少性肥胖老年人步态和平衡运动干预的范围综述（13 项研究，502 例）发现，运动训练（力量、阻力、多组分）改善了步态速度、步长、功能活动度、静态平衡和姿势控制，且不良反应轻微。大多数研究（近 70%）针对老年女性，限制了结果对老年男性的普适性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates potential benefits of exercise training for gait and balance in older adults with sarcopenic obesity. When designing rehabilitation programs for this population, prioritize power, resistance, and multicomponent training, but be aware that current research primarily focuses on older women, and generalizability to older men needs further confirmation.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，纳入的 13 项研究中近 70% 仅针对老年女性，因此结果对老年男性的普适性存疑。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review includes 13 studies, nearly 70% of which focused solely on older women, raising questions about the generalizability of the findings to older men.
items.journal: European Review of Aging and Physical Activity

items.title: Effect of mesenchymal stem cell-Derived secretome injection on functional outcomes after anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction using peroneus longus tendon autograft: a double-blind randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A double-blind RCT (n=24) comparing ACL reconstruction with peroneus longus tendon autograft with or without mesenchymal stem cell (MSC)-derived secretome injection found the secretome group had significantly higher IKDC (86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01) and Tegner–Lysholm scores (87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01) at six months post-op. No major adverse events were reported.
items.curatedReason: 这项小样本 RCT 提示，在 ACL 重建手术中辅助注射 MSC 衍生的分泌组可提高 6 个月后的患者报告膝关节功能评分。尽管结果积极，但样本量小，且仅为短期功能结局，尚不能将其作为常规临床实践，应等待更大样本和长期随访的研究结果。
items.titleZh: 间充质干细胞分泌组注射对腓骨长肌腱自体移植物前交叉韧带重建术后功能结局的影响：一项双盲随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验（24 例）比较了采用腓骨长肌腱自体移植物进行前交叉韧带（ACL）重建术后是否辅助注射间充质干细胞（MSC）分泌组。结果显示，分泌组在术后 6 个月时 IKDC 评分（86.89 ± 5.11 vs. 78.27 ± 3.91; p < 0.01）和 Tegner–Lysholm 评分（87.08 ± 5.16 vs. 79.33 ± 2.67; p < 0.01）显著更高。未报告主要不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This small-sample RCT suggests that adjunctive injection of MSC-derived secretome during ACL reconstruction may improve patient-reported knee function scores at 6 months. While positive, the small sample size and short-term functional outcomes mean it cannot be adopted as routine clinical practice yet; larger trials with long-term follow-up are needed.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量非常小（24 名参与者），随访期仅为 6 个月，且关注的是患者报告结局而非生物学愈合指标，结果的长期有效性和生物学机制仍需进一步研究。
items.limitationEn: This study has a very small sample size (24 participants) and a follow-up period of only 6 months. It focuses on patient-reported outcomes rather than biological healing markers, so the long-term efficacy and biological mechanisms require further investigation.

items.title: Paired cerebrospinal fluid metabolomic changes across repeated anodal transcranial direct current stimulation in Parkinson’s disease: an exploratory within-subject study
items.summary: An exploratory within-subject study (n=14 Parkinson's disease patients) found that five consecutive daily sessions of anodal transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) were accompanied by significant within-participant decreases in UPDRS-III (p=0.035) and NMSS-K (p < 0.001), and increases in MoCA-K (p=0.011). CSF metabolomic changes included increased purine-related and tyrosine/levodopa-related metabolites and altered non-polar lipids. The study lacked a sham control.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究发现，重复经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）可引起帕金森病患者脑脊液代谢组学和临床症状的短期变化。尽管提示 tDCS 可能的生物学效应，但由于缺乏假对照组，你不能将此结果视为确切的治疗证据，仍需等待随机对照试验。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病重复阳极经颅直流电刺激后的配对脑脊液代谢组学变化：一项探索性受试者内研究。
items.summaryZh: 一项探索性受试者内研究（14 名帕金森病患者）发现，连续五天的阳极经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）伴随受试者内 UPDRS-III（p=0.035）和 NMSS-K（p < 0.001）的显著下降，以及 MoCA-K（p=0.011）的显著增加。脑脊液代谢组学变化包括嘌呤相关和酪氨酸/左旋多巴相关代谢物增加，以及非极性脂质改变。本研究缺乏假对照组。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study found that repeated transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) may induce short-term changes in cerebrospinal fluid metabolomics and clinical symptoms in Parkinson's disease patients. While suggesting potential biological effects of tDCS, due to the lack of a sham control group, you should not consider these results as definitive treatment evidence and must await randomized controlled trials.
items.limitation: 本研究样本量小（14 名帕金森病患者），且缺乏假对照组，无法确立干预措施的有效性或 tDCS 特异性因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This study has a small sample size (14 Parkinson's disease patients) and lacks a sham control group, thus unable to establish intervention efficacy or tDCS-specific causality.

items.title: Mapping evidence on whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises for postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot: a scoping review
items.summary: A scoping review (21 studies) mapped evidence on whole-body vibration (WBV) and lumbar stabilization exercises (LSE) for postural control in flexible flatfoot (FF). It found very limited direct evidence for WBV or LSE specifically in FF, with most insights derived from related populations. The effectiveness and safety of these interventions in FF remain uncertain, highlighting a need for RCTs.
items.curatedReason: 这篇范围综述指出，全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者步态控制的证据极为有限，现有证据多来自相关人群。在临床实践中，若无针对柔性扁平足的直接 RCT 证据，应谨慎应用这些干预措施。
items.titleZh: 全身振动和腰部稳定训练对柔性扁平足患者姿势控制的影响：一项范围综述。
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述（21 项研究）梳理了全身振动（WBV）和腰部稳定训练（LSE）对柔性扁平足（FF）患者姿势控制的证据。研究发现，针对 FF 的 WBV 或 LSE 直接证据非常有限，多数见解来自相关人群。这些干预措施在 FF 患者中的有效性和安全性仍不确定，亟需随机对照试验。
items.curatedReasonEn: This scoping review indicates extremely limited evidence for whole-body vibration and lumbar stabilization exercises improving postural control in individuals with flexible flatfoot, with most existing evidence from related populations. In clinical practice, apply these interventions cautiously without direct RCT evidence for flexible flatfoot.
items.limitation: 本研究为范围综述，主要旨在识别研究空白，而非评估干预措施的有效性，且纳入的大多数证据来自与柔性扁平足相关的其他人群。
items.limitationEn: This scoping review primarily aims to identify research gaps rather than evaluate intervention effectiveness, and most included evidence is from populations related to flexible flatfoot.

items.title: Cryoneurolysis as an effective spasticity treatment option : a case series
items.summary: A case series of eight patients with neuropathic gait or lower extremity pain, weakness, and spasticity found that cryoneurolysis of certain nerves provided immediate benefits lasting a few months to one year. The authors conclude that cryoneurolysis can be a safe and efficient treatment option for spasticity.
items.curatedReason: 这组病例报告显示冷冻神经松解术可有效治疗痉挛，且效果持续数月至一年。虽然这提供了新的治疗可能性，但病例报告证据级别较低，不应将其作为常规方案，而应视为探索性辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 冷冻神经松解术作为一种有效的痉挛治疗选择：一个病例系列。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 8 名神经性步态或下肢疼痛、无力及痉挛患者的病例系列研究发现，对特定神经进行冷冻神经松解术可提供即时益处，持续数月至一年。作者得出结论，冷冻神经松解术可以作为一种安全有效的痉挛治疗选择。
items.curatedReasonEn: This case series indicates that cryoneurolysis can effectively treat spasticity, with effects lasting several months to a year. While it offers a new treatment possibility, case reports are low-level evidence and should not be considered a routine intervention, but rather an exploratory adjunct.
items.limitation: 本研究为病例系列，样本量极小（8 例），且缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然病程影响，证据级别低。
items.limitationEn: This is a case series with an extremely small sample size (8 cases) and no control group, making it impossible to rule out placebo effects or natural disease progression, thus representing low-level evidence.

items.title: A Return to Performance Continuum for Football (Soccer) Players After ACL Reconstruction: Bridging Rehabilitation, Return to Play and Sustained Performance.
items.summary: A paper outlines a staged Return to Performance continuum for football players after ACL reconstruction, bridging rehabilitation and sustained performance. It emphasizes restoring movement quality, progressive football-specific technical/tactical retraining, physical reconditioning, and maximal strength restoration.
items.curatedReason: 这篇共识论文提出了 ACL 重建术后足球运动员重返运动和持续表现的连续体框架，弥补了传统康复与高水平竞技表现之间的鸿沟。它为你在 ACLR 患者管理中提供了更细致的分期和评估指标，特别是针对竞技运动员。
items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后足球运动员重返表现连续体：连接康复、重返赛场和持续表现。
items.summaryZh: 一篇论文概述了 ACL 重建术后足球运动员重返表现的阶段性连续体，旨在连接康复与持续表现。它强调恢复运动质量、循序渐进的足球专项技术和战术再训练、体能再调节以及最大力量恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This consensus paper proposes a continuum framework for return to performance and sustained performance in football players after ACL reconstruction, bridging the gap between traditional rehabilitation and high-level athletic demands. It offers you more detailed staging and evaluation metrics for managing ACLR patients, especially competitive athletes.
items.limitation: 该文章为专家意见和共识，而非基于随机对照试验的证据。
items.limitationEn: This article represents expert opinion and consensus, rather than evidence based on randomized controlled trials.

items.title: Adherence to home-based exercise therapy in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain: a cross-sectional study of 491 participants of the ComPaRE cLBP e-cohort (ADHERE II).
items.summary: A cross-sectional study of 491 adults with non-specific chronic low back pain found that 45% were adherent to home-based exercise therapy. Higher pre-cLBP physical activity and lower cLBP intensity were associated with better adherence, but supervision did not significantly influence it.
items.curatedReason: 这项观察性研究提示，慢性非特异性腰痛患者居家运动治疗依从性不足一半（45%），且监督形式对依从性影响不显著。这表明了当前居家方案的局限性，促使你重新审视患者筛选和依从性支持策略。
items.titleZh: 慢性非特异性腰痛成人居家运动治疗依从性：一项针对 491 名 ComPaRE cLBP 电子队列参与者的横断面研究 (ADHERE II)。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 491 名慢性非特异性腰痛成人患者的横断面研究发现，居家运动治疗依从性为 45%。较高的腰痛前身体活动水平和较低的腰痛强度与更好的依从性相关，但监督形式对其影响不显著。
items.curatedReasonEn: This observational study suggests that home-based exercise therapy adherence in adults with non-specific chronic low back pain is less than half (45%), and supervision methods do not significantly influence adherence. This highlights the limitations of current home-based programs and prompts you to reassess patient selection and adherence support strategies.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面观察性研究，无法建立因果关系，且依从性数据基于患者自评量表。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional observational study cannot establish causality, and adherence data is based on self-reported questionnaires.
items.journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society

items.title: Validity and Reliability of Accelerometers to Evaluate Preschool-Aged Children’s Physical Activity and Sedentary Behavior During Free-Living Condition: A Systematic Review
items.summary: A systematic review assesses the validity and reliability of accelerometers in evaluating physical activity and sedentary behavior among preschool-aged children during free-living conditions.
items.curatedReason: 评估学龄前儿童身体活动和久坐行为时，加速计确实是一种有潜力的工具。然而，这篇系统综述告诉你，你需要充分理解其有效性和可靠性的局限性，以确保在儿童康复和发育评估中选择合适的测量方法。
items.titleZh: 加速计评估学龄前儿童自由生活条件下身体活动和久坐行为的有效性和可靠性：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述评估了加速计在评估学龄前儿童自由生活条件下身体活动和久坐行为方面的有效性和可靠性。
items.curatedReasonEn: Accelerometers are indeed a promising tool for evaluating physical activity and sedentary behavior in preschool-aged children. However, this systematic review tells you that you need to fully understand the limitations of their validity and reliability to ensure you select appropriate measurement methods for pediatric rehabilitation and developmental assessment.
items.journal: Measurement in Physical Education and Exercise Science

items.title: Appraisal of Clinical Practice Guideline: physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder.
items.summary: This article provides an appraisal of a clinical practice guideline focused on the physical therapy management of children diagnosed with developmental coordination disorder.
items.curatedReason: 这篇关于发育性协调障碍儿童物理治疗管理临床实践指南的评估，直接关联到儿童康复的临床决策。它能帮助你了解现有指南的质量和推荐，从而优化你对这类患儿的干预方案。
items.titleZh: 临床实践指南评估：发育性协调障碍儿童的物理治疗管理。
items.summaryZh: 本文评估了一项关于发育性协调障碍儿童物理治疗管理的临床实践指南。
items.curatedReasonEn: This appraisal of a clinical practice guideline for physical therapy management of children with developmental coordination disorder directly informs you about the quality and recommendations of existing guidelines, making your intervention decisions more evidence-based. You should definitely use this appraisal to review your current clinical decisions for these children.

items.title: Hockey players who wont play through concussions
items.summary: An athlete recounts experiencing concussion symptoms after a hockey hit, describing memory loss and the subsequent adherence to a sports medicine clinic's recovery protocol and school-mandated exertion symptom reporting.
items.curatedReason: 虽然只是个案分享，但这篇 BJSM 博客文章提供了一个运动员在脑震荡后依从康复方案的真实经历。你可以用它来和患者进行教育或共情沟通，它也提醒我们关注年轻运动员的症状管理和康复心理，尤其是在记忆力受损的情况下。
items.titleZh: 不再带着脑震荡上场的曲棍球运动员
items.summaryZh: 一名运动员回忆了在曲棍球比赛中头部撞击后出现脑震荡症状的经历，包括失忆，以及随后如何遵守运动医学诊所的康复方案和学校规定的劳累后症状报告要求。
items.curatedReasonEn: Though just an individual account, this BJSM blog post offers a real-world example of an athlete adhering to a concussion recovery protocol. You can use it for patient education or empathetic communication, and it reminds us to focus on symptom management and the psychological aspects of recovery for young athletes, especially when memory loss is involved.

items.title: The effects of route previewing on adaptive gait and gaze behaviour under cognitive dual-task conditions in older adults
items.summary: This study found that cognitive dual-tasking increased stepping errors and reduced stride length, but route previewing significantly mitigated these negative effects on adaptive gait and gaze behavior. Previewing prior to gait initiation helped participants look further ahead and make fewer irrelevant fixations, improving walking safety under cognitive load.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究表明，对于老年人，在认知双任务条件下，路线预判可以显著减轻自适应步态和注视行为的负面影响，减少步态错误和交叉步。这提示你在对老年患者进行步态训练时，可以纳入预判策略，通过支持视觉运动规划来提高其在复杂环境中的行走安全性。
items.titleZh: 认知双任务条件下路线预判对老年人适应性步态和注视行为的即时影响。
items.summaryZh: 这项研究发现，认知双任务处理会增加步态错误并缩短步幅，但路线预判能显著减轻这些负面影响，改善适应性步态和注视行为。在步态启动前进行预判有助于参与者看得更远并减少无关注视，从而提高认知负荷下的行走安全性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study shows that route previewing significantly mitigates the negative effects of cognitive dual-tasking on adaptive gait and gaze behavior in older adults, reducing stepping errors and cross-steps. This suggests that when conducting gait training for older patients, you can incorporate previewing strategies to enhance their walking safety in complex environments by supporting visual-motor planning.
items.limitation: 研究样本量适中（社区老年人），且在受控实验室环境下进行，结果的外推性到真实复杂环境可能受限。
items.limitationEn: The study had a moderate sample size (community-dwelling older adults) and was conducted in a controlled laboratory setting, potentially limiting the generalizability of the findings to real-world complex environments.

items.title: From information to action; co-designing pain neuroscience education for adolescents with low back pain: Focus group insights.
items.summary: This study co-designed pain neuroscience education (PNE) material for adolescents with low back pain (LBP). Four focus groups with 15 participants initially, and one more with 6, guided the development of the "Back To Move" prototype, emphasizing back-specific, practical, trustworthy, and engaging content.
items.curatedReason: 本研究通过与青少年共同设计，成功开发了青少年下腰痛PNE教育材料。其设计原则是提升青少年对疼痛教育的接受度，将背痛特定信息、实用工具和易于查找的格式相结合。
items.titleZh: 从信息到行动；共同设计青少年下腰痛疼痛神经科学教育：焦点小组洞见。
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过与患有下腰痛的青少年共同设计，开发了疼痛神经科学教育（PNE）材料。基于与15名和6名青少年参与者的焦点小组讨论，最终的“Back To Move”原型强调了提供与背痛相关、实用、可信且吸引人的内容的重要性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study successfully co-designed PNE educational material for adolescents with low back pain. The design principles emphasize making pain education more acceptable to adolescents by combining back-specific information, practical tools, and an easy-to-find format.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This was a qualitative study with a small sample size, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Physical therapy care utilization and associated sociodemographic and clinical factors among noncommunicable diseases in the brazilian population: A cross-sectional, population-based study.
items.summary: This cross-sectional study of 88,531 Brazilians with noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) found stroke had the highest physical therapy utilization (17.0%). Follow-up by a healthcare professional was a common associated factor across NCDs, with pharmacotherapy, age ≥60 years, and severe activity limitation also significant for specific conditions.
items.curatedReason: 这项针对88,531名巴西NCD患者的研究提示，卒中患者物理治疗利用率最高（17.0%）。对所有NCD患者而言，定期随访、药物治疗、年龄≥60岁及严重活动受限，均与物理治疗利用率相关，你在推广服务时应优先关注这些群体。
items.titleZh: 巴西人口非传染性疾病患者物理治疗利用率及其社会人口学和临床相关因素：一项基于人群的横断面研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项针对88,531名巴西非传染性疾病（NCDs）患者的横断面研究显示，卒中患者的物理治疗利用率最高（17.0%）。医疗专业人员的随访是所有NCDs患者物理治疗利用的共同相关因素，特定疾病还与药物治疗、年龄≥60岁和严重活动受限有关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study of 88,531 Brazilian NCD patients suggests that stroke patients have the highest physical therapy utilization (17.0%). For all NCD patients, regular follow-up, pharmacotherapy, age ≥60 years, and severe activity limitation are associated with physical therapy utilization, so prioritize these groups when promoting services.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，且数据来自2019年调查，可能无法反映最新情况。
items.limitationEn: This cross-sectional study cannot establish causality, and data from a 2019 survey may not reflect current conditions.

items.title: The effects of blood flow restriction training on lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients: a randomized clinical trial.
items.summary: A 3-week randomized clinical trial (N=96) found both blood flow restriction (BFR) walking and low-load resistance training with BFR (LL-BFR) significantly improved lower limb motor function (FMA-LE: +1.66 to +2.25 points) and balance in stroke patients compared to control, with 34.4% of LL-BFR participants achieving MCID vs. 15.6% in control. No serious adverse events occurred.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT证实，对于卒中患者，为期3周的血流限制（BFR）步行或低负荷阻力训练结合BFR，比传统训练更能改善下肢运动功能和平衡。FMA-LE得分平均改善1.66至2.25分，且未报告严重不良事件。尽管平均改善幅度适中，但更多患者可获得临床有意义的改善，这表明BFR作为卒中康复的辅助手段值得考虑，并可能提升患者功能预后。
items.titleZh: 血流限制训练对卒中患者下肢运动功能和平衡的影响：一项随机临床试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项为期3周的随机临床试验（N=96）发现，血流限制（BFR）步行和结合BFR的低负荷阻力训练（LL-BFR）均显著改善了卒中患者的下肢运动功能（FMA-LE：+1.66至+2.25分）和平衡，优于对照组。LL-BFR组有34.4%的患者达到临床最小重要差异（MCID），而对照组为15.6%。未发生严重不良事件。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT confirms that 3 weeks of blood flow restriction (BFR) walking or low-load resistance training with BFR significantly improves lower limb motor function and balance in stroke patients compared to conventional training, with average FMA-LE improvements of 1.66 to 2.25 points and no serious adverse events. While the average improvement is modest, a greater number of patients may achieve clinically meaningful improvement, indicating BFR warrants consideration as an adjunctive stroke rehabilitation modality and potentially improves functional outcomes.
items.limitation: 研究随访时间较短（3周），样本量适中，BFR的长期疗效和普适性尚需更大规模、更长时间的RCT验证。
items.limitationEn: The study had a short follow-up (3 weeks) and moderate sample size; long-term efficacy and generalizability of BFR require larger, longer-term RCTs.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: "It's not for me": community-based fall prevention exercise programs for those aging into disability.
items.summary: This qualitative study explored barriers to community-based fall prevention exercise programs for 11 adults aged 50+ with self-reported mobility or sensory impairments. Four themes emerged, highlighting multidimensional accessibility challenges, stigma, program misalignment, and self-stereotyping. Co-designing inclusive, flexible, and identity-affirming programs is suggested.
items.curatedReason: 这项定性研究揭示了老年人跌倒预防锻炼项目在招募和参与上面临的多维度障碍，特别是对残疾老年群体。发现污名化、项目不匹配和自我刻板印象是主要障碍。这提示你需要重新思考跌倒预防项目的推广和设计，通过共同设计策略，打造更具包容性和身份认同感的项目。
items.titleZh: “这不适合我”：针对“渐进性残疾”老年人的社区跌倒预防运动项目。
items.summaryZh: 这项定性研究探讨了11名50岁以上自报有行动或感觉障碍的成年人参与社区跌倒预防运动项目的障碍。研究归纳出四个主题，强调了多维度可及性挑战、污名化、项目不匹配和自我刻板印象。研究建议共同设计包容、灵活且身份认同的方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: This qualitative study reveals multidimensional barriers to recruitment and participation in fall prevention exercise programs for older adults, particularly those with disabilities. Stigma, program misalignment, and self-stereotyping were identified as major deterrents. This suggests you need to rethink the promotion and design of fall prevention programs, using co-design strategies to create more inclusive and identity-affirming initiatives.
items.limitation: 本研究为定性研究，样本量小（11名参与者），且依赖参与者的自我报告，结果的普适性受限。
items.limitationEn: This qualitative study has a small sample size (11 participants) and relies on self-reported data, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: A normative torque-profile approach for quantifying elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance after stroke: a proof-of-principle study
items.summary: This proof-of-principle study introduced ScoreE, an isokinetic dynamometry metric, to objectively quantify post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance in 35 patients. ScoreE demonstrated good to excellent inter-rater (ICC 0.81-0.89) and test-retest reliability (ICC 0.76-0.93), with moderate associations with Modified Ashworth Scale (MAS) grades, providing a reliable tool for longitudinal monitoring.
items.curatedReason: 这项概念验证研究提出了一种新的等速测力学指标ScoreE，用于客观量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。该指标具有良好的评定者间和重测信度（ICC范围0.76-0.93），且与MAS量表评分中度相关。ScoreE为客观监测卒中痉挛和评估干预效果提供了一个有潜力的工具，有助于你更精准地评估患者进展。
items.titleZh: 一种量化卒中后肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗的常模扭矩-轮廓方法：一项概念验证研究。
items.summaryZh: 这项概念验证研究引入了等速测力学指标ScoreE，以客观量化35名卒中患者的肘关节和腕关节屈肌过度抵抗。ScoreE表现出良好至卓越的评定者间（ICC 0.81-0.89）和重测信度（ICC 0.76-0.93），并与改良Ashworth量表（MAS）评分呈中度相关，为长期监测提供了一个可靠工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This proof-of-principle study introduces ScoreE, a novel isokinetic dynamometry-derived metric for objectively quantifying post-stroke elbow and wrist flexor hyper-resistance. The metric demonstrates good to excellent inter-rater and test-retest reliability (ICC range 0.76-0.93) and moderate associations with MAS grades. ScoreE offers a promising tool for objectively monitoring stroke spasticity and evaluating intervention effects, helping you more precisely assess patient progress.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（35名卒中患者），且对振动干预后的反应性评估为探索性，未进行正式评估，需更大规模研究验证其临床敏感性和响应性。
items.limitationEn: The study had a small sample size (35 stroke patients), and the responsiveness to vibration intervention was exploratory without formal assessment, requiring larger studies to validate clinical sensitivity and responsiveness.
